links.comparator_used: Uninstructed prompt (models answered the cases without the structured-plan instruction); also tested against a request for 25 recommendations
links.outcome: Severity-weighted F1 on NOHARM v2 public cases (mainly graded on omissions)
links.effect: Mean F1 rose by 0.14 [0.09, 0.20], improving 4 of 5 models (Grok 4.7 0.354 to 0.633; GPT-5.6 Terra 0.678 to 0.853). Three instructed models exceeded the best uninstructed score (0.764). Between-model SD halved (0.17 to 0.09). The plan format alone matched the full instruction; the framing alone or 25 recommendations scored lower.
links.tradeoff: Added some harmful options: one model proposed +0.13 [+0.05, +0.23] more specialist-rated harmful options per item, and a physician judged 13 of the 43 added options harmful as stated. Most recovered actions were follow-up and counseling.
links.quote: The instruction raised F1 by 0.14 on average [0.09, 0.20] and improved 4 of 5 models, most for the tersest (Grok 4.7, 0.354 to 0.633; GPT-5.6 Terra, 0.678 to 0.853).

design_hint: structured prompt instruction requesting complete plan (prompt guardrail) with review of added actions
